Replace the crontab on the old server with systemd timers so that failures show up in the journal and missed runs are caught up after a reboot.

## Outcome
All seven jobs migrated, each with a unit and a timer file. The nightly cleanup now logs to the journal. The crontab was emptied and a comment pointing at the timers was left in it.
